$description: AVAN GROUP · A3.1 Motion & Animation · Global + Semantic + Component + Pattern tiers (W3C DTCG). Single source of truth for the motion language. avan-state-tokens.json aliases into {easing.standard}, {easing.settle}, {duration.fast}, {duration.normal}; consumed downstream by B5 Animation Library and B6.7 Runtime Performance. Motion is purposeful, swift, quiet — the house does not perform.

linear.$description: No acceleration. Progress bars, spinners, looping shimmer only.

standard.$description: House decelerate curve. The default for entrances and most interface motion — fast on, settles soft.

accelerate.$description: Ease-in. Exits and elements leaving the screen — gathers speed as it departs.

in-out.$description: Symmetric. Movement that begins and ends on screen — reordering, slide-between.

emphasized.$description: Strong, weighted decelerate. Reserved for deliberate moments — modals, shared-element transitions.

settle.$description: A single, restrained overshoot. Permitted ONLY on the toggle knob. The house does not bounce elsewhere.

instant.$description: No animation. State applied immediately — focus rings, reduced-motion fallback.

fast.$description: Micro-feedback. Button press, hover color shift, checkbox tick.

normal.$description: The workhorse. Fades, slides, scales, toggles — most interface motion.

slow.$description: Larger surfaces. Popovers, drawers, expanding panels.

deliberate.$description: Consequential transitions. Page changes, shared elements, modal entrance.

frame-budget.$description: 60fps ceiling. Every animation must hold one frame within this budget.

animatable-properties.$description: The only properties motion may touch. Layout and paint properties are forbidden.

pattern-fade.$description: Opacity 0→1. Content swaps, tooltips, overlays appearing in place.

pattern-slide.$description: translateY/X paired with fade. Direction carries meaning — entrances rise, exits depart. Distance set by slide-distance.

slide-distance.$description: Travel for the slide pattern. Range 8–16px by surface size; 16px is the default. Sign and axis are set by direction.

pattern-scale.$description: scale 0.96→1 with fade. Surfaces emerging from a trigger — menus, popovers, modals.

stagger-interval.$description: Delay between sequential children. After stagger-cap, remaining children enter together so the sequence never drags.

stagger-cap.$description: Maximum staggered children (8 items / 320ms total). Beyond this, items enter simultaneously.

scale-from.$description: Origin scale for emerging surfaces (pattern-scale, modal-enter) and button press. Grows to 1.0; never overshoots — the toggle knob is the sole exception.

duration.$description: Under prefers-reduced-motion, all motion collapses to an opacity-only fade at this duration.

timingFunction.$description: No translate, no scale, no shimmer. Cross-fade replaces every spatial transition.

button-press-scale.$description: Active-state compression. Returns to 1 on release.

toggle-knob.$description: translateX across the track. The one permitted overshoot in the system.

checkbox-draw.$description: Checkmark stroke draws via stroke-dashoffset. Box fill cross-fades beneath.

toggle-knob-travel.$description: translateX distance of the toggle knob between off and on. Snaps to position with no overshoot under reduced motion.

focus-ring.$description: Focus is exempt from motion — the ring appears at instant so keyboard users never wait to see where they are.

page-enter-forward.$description: Forward navigation: new view enters from the right with fade. Back reverses (enters from left).

modal-enter.$description: scale 0.96→1 + fade; scrim fades in beneath at {duration.slow}.

sheet-enter.$description: Bottom sheet / drawer slides from edge with the scrim.

shared-element.$description: A matched element morphs position and size between routes — continuity of identity.

skeleton-shimmer.$description: Looping highlight sweep over placeholder blocks. Collapses to a static block under reduced motion.
